title: Escondido RV Resort

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Nestled amidst the avocado and citrus groves, Escondido RV Resort is the perfect destination for a San Diego getaway, family holiday, or seasonal stay. Our lushly landscaped and big rig-friendly resort features 125 concrete RV sites with 30- and 50-amp electrical service, free wireless internet, water and sewer hookups, and beautiful scenery. Our spacious RV sites offer the freedom to breathe in a relaxing atmosphere, complete with access to fun activities and amenities, including our outdoor pool and dog park. services.name: Vacation Rentals
services.desc: Sophistication and style meet relaxation and comfort in our luxurious Emerald Desert RV Resort rental Villas. Available in a range of sizes, including Studio Efficiency, Suite, and One, Two, and Three-Bedroom configurations, each Villa comes fully equipped for a comfortable stay. Kitchens or kitchenettes include a stovetop, microwave, coffee pot, and refrigerator, and all Villas are stocked with kitchenware and place settings for six to eight guests. Bed linens and bath towels are provided, and select Villas also feature private patio areas with outdoor seating and pull-out sofas. Visit our website for more details.
